benchmark_config.name: llp_forward-reach
benchmark_config.description:
Muon-philic scalar LLP reach study (collider-forward, full spectrum).
From a pinned model card, the agent GENERATES the forward meson flux
with the provided Pythia cards, harvests it (per-collision normalized),
decays it to the scalar across every open channel -- pseudoscalar
M -> mu nu phi (pi/K/D/Ds) and vector V -> mu mu phi (rho/omega/phi/
J/psi/psi2S) -- derives the phi -> mu mu (tree) and phi -> gamma gamma
(one-loop) widths, propagates through a decay-in-flight / z_prod decay
volume, and reports N_sig at a declared set of (search, m_phi, g)
points spanning the gamma gamma lobe, the dimuon wedge, and the charm/
J-psi high-mass frontier. All pins are declared toy values.

GRADING is by CALIBRATED DISTANCE: a symbolic/value width check, then a
median |log10(agent/reference)| in dex on the yields and separately on each
reach-contour edge, standardised by the reference's own measured
Monte-Carlo precision rather than by a chosen tolerance. See
analysis/notes/accuracy_metric.tex.

THE SUPERSEDED TOLERANCE LADDER (peak_yield + band_coarse/mid/fine) now
lives in benchmarks/llp_forward_legacy, which inherits everything else from
here. It is retained so the 2026-07 campaign and the 2026-08-09 pilot stay
reproducible; it must not grade new work. Running THIS benchmark is what
gets you the live rubric -- which is the point of the move, since the
arrangement was previously inverted and grading the parent silently gave
the old ladder.

stages.description: results/answer.json holds the probes AND results/scan.csv holds the scans.

A forward-flux artifact exists. NON-GATING here: it is satisfied for free in every scaffolded variant by the .cmnd cards we ship, so as a gate it only ever fired on file-NAMING in the bare variant, where no cards are supplied. It reports, it does not zero a trial.
derived widths and lifetime, formula + probe values.
fraction of reference-reached (search, mass) points carrying any yield.

Yield accuracy at the reference's OWN declared (search, m_phi, g) points, the agent's scan interpolated in log-log onto those couplings. 48 graded points, no grid dependence. NOT compared against `_per_mass.peak`: that is the max of the reference's internal 400-point scan at a coupling the declared set never samples, and comparing it to the max of an agent's own grid measured the mismatch rather than the physics (~0.48 dex for cells whose band edges agree to 0.005-0.03 dex). The PRIMARY accuracy stage.

Reach-contour accuracy at the WEAK-coupling boundary, which is production-limited: below it too few LLPs are made, and those that are live long enough to fly through the volume undecayed. Graded separately from the upper edge -- they are different physics and respond differently to method. On the 2026-08 campaign a single trial sat at 0.0028 dex here and 0.066 at the other edge, a factor 19; pooling them turned a bimodal distribution into a misleading unimodal one.

Reach-contour accuracy at the STRONG-coupling boundary, which is lifetime-limited: above it c*tau ~ 1/g^2 is short enough that the LLP decays before reaching the volume. This edge is set by parents decaying just upstream of the absorber -- a thin sliver of the parent decay-length distribution -- so it is the sample-starved observable and needs the finest decay-length sampling. Weighted below the lower edge for that reason.
no invented exclusion where the reference has none.
the requested figure exists and carries filled regions.

variants.name: bare
variants.description:
OUT-OF-THE-BOX. Everything the answer depends on is stated in the USER
PROMPT, and the sandbox ships one file: results/answer_schema.json, the
output contract. This is the closest variant to "open a harness and ask a
colleague for this analysis".

WHY EVERYTHING IS IN THE PROMPT. It is not only realism. What the agent was
given becomes a single reviewable artifact instead of three files in two
formats, and a prescription can no longer hide in a config file -- which is
exactly how the v1 formulation failed (see HISTORY). It also removes a
non-physics failure mode: not reading, or misparsing, a supplied .tex.

WHAT IS PINNED, and why each is necessary for truth.json to be the unique
answer:
  the Lagrangian                fixes both widths and c*tau
  the two width expressions     see AXES below
  production topologies         P -> mu nu phi, V -> mu+ mu- phi. Names the
                                process; without it an agent can miss the
                                vector channel and with it the entire
                                high-mass reach
  sqrt(s), generator, tune      the flux is a SIMULATION OUTPUT, not a fact.
                                Two generators, or two tunes, give different
                                forward strangeness and therefore different
                                N_sig
  soft QCD + charmonium         charmonium is the ONLY source above
                                m_phi ~ 1.76 GeV, where the pseudoscalars
                                close. An agent running plain SoftQCD gets
                                zero yield at m_phi = 1.9 and 2.3 -- 8 of the
                                48 graded points -- and that is a generator
                                switch, not physics they can derive.
                                The word "prompt" USED to appear here and was
                                removed: it reads as an instruction to run a
                                dedicated NRQCD onia sample, which is what
                                both arms of the 2026-08-09 pilot did, and
                                that route undercounts the forward J/psi
                                flux by 1.32x. Deliberately NOT replaced with
                                the recipe -- see WHAT IS WITHHELD
  harvest at production         the LLP decay is BSM and absent from the
                                generator, so parents must be caught before
                                they decay
  theta_max = 0.05 rad          NOT droppable. The volume subtends
                                0.92/112 = 8.2 mrad, so 10 mrad reads as
                                generous -- and loses 20% of the yield,
                                because the phi is not collinear with its
                                parent. Measured retention: 73.9% at
                                8.2 mrad, 80.4% at 10, 93.5% at 20,
                                100.000% at 50
  sigma_inel, N_int             set the absolute normalization
  the geometry pins             the apparatus
  the two acceptance defs       arbitrary detector definitions
  N* = 3                        defines the contour
  the mass grid, the probes     where the answer is evaluated
  the output contract           interface, held constant across variants

WHAT IS WITHHELD -- this is the work: which hadrons can radiate a phi (the
parent enumeration), B_hat and the rest-frame energy spectra, the
decay-in-flight production vertex, P_dec, the ray/cylinder intersection, the
acceptance algorithms, the g^2 reweighting, and how many events to generate.

ALSO WITHHELD, and worth its own note: the generator recipe for charmonium.
The reference uses ONE inclusive sample (SoftQCD with Onia switched on in the
same run). A dedicated NRQCD onia sample run alongside a separate soft-QCD
one is 1.32x low, and that is not a convention mismatch -- it is an
INCOMPLETE FLUX. Measured at 13.6 TeV / Monash, forward J/psi per inelastic
collision: inclusive 1.074e-3, dedicated-only 8.07e-4. Soft QCD with Onia OFF
still makes 2.48e-4 from string fragmentation, and 52 of 59 have no b-hadron
ancestor, so it is not feed-down -- it is a real production mechanism the
dedicated NRQCD run simply does not have. The combination is additive rather
than double-counted: 126 (onia) + 39 (soft) = 165 against 168 observed, so
the onia processes are not ALSO generated inside MPI and Pythia's "should not
combine softQCD processes with hard ones" warning does not bite.

So the task asks for the total forward charmonium flux and an agent that
delivers 76% of it has undercounted, which is gradeable physics rather than
a coin flip. That is why the prompt does NOT state the recipe: encoding it is
exactly the kind of domain practice the llp bundle should carry, and holding
it out of the prompt is what makes the tools arm's advantage real signal
instead of a common-mode offset that cancels. SoftQCD:all and
SoftQCD:inelastic are interchangeable here (kaons agree to 0.3%); the
load-bearing part is only that charmonium is in the same run.

NOT PINNED, deliberately: the in-volume midpoint convention the reference
uses to evaluate acceptance. It is worth <= 0.004 dex for the dimuon search
and is EXACTLY zero for the diphoton search (the photons follow the phi's own
line, so the decay position cancels algebraically). An agent that samples the
true decay point will be marginally more correct than the reference, by an
amount below its noise floor. See analysis/notes/detector_model.tex.

Also not pinned: pt_cut. It is the soft/hard stitching point in the reference
generator, but n_hard = 0 in every flux ever built, so nothing is stitched
and it has no effect.

PAIRS WITH EITHER ARM. Earlier revisions of this file said "core-only by
design", because MesonDecayToLLP required `kappa` and `spectrum_spec` as
inputs and this variant withholds the files that supplied them, leaving the
central domain tool unusable. Heptapod 2.5.0 adds ProductionSpectrumTool,
which COMPUTES the spectrum and the reduced branching fraction from a parent
name and a mass -- precisely what is withheld here. So `bare` x `core_only`
versus `bare` x `tools_defined` is now runnable, and it is the cleanest
tools-versus-no-tools contrast in the suite.

HISTORY. v1 (2026-08-06) created no headroom over the scaffolded core cell
(0.935 vs 0.900). An audit found `geometry.yaml` was not a geometry file: a
"DECLARED CONVENTIONS" banner gave away the decay-in-flight vertex, the
[L1,L2] ray/cylinder intersection, P_dec with lambda = beta*gamma*c*tau, the
midpoint evaluation together with its g-independence rationale, and both
acceptance algorithms step by step. Stages 4 and 5 were simply handed over.
v2 withheld the prescriptions and kept the arbitrary pins, and also dropped
the table of eight named parents from reference.tex. This revision folds the
surviving pins into the prompt, supplies the widths (see AXES), and reduces
the sandbox to the output contract.
